summary: BifrOSt has typed pasteboard, typed drag and drop, the share picker and UTType conformance, all keyed by UTType ids and raw payloads. It has no Transferable protocol or TransferRepresentation for app model types, so apps cannot declare how a model type moves through copy, drag or share.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs; wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (pasteboard_item, from_pasteboard_item, drag_item, begin_drag, drop_values); springboard/sdk/src/item_provider.rs
features.note: Sprint 10: Transferable trait with Representations builder (data, codable, file, proxy, proxy_of), exportedContentType and importedContentTypes, NSItemProvider (item_provider.rs: loadTransferable). Host tests only (sdk/tests/transferable.rs); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/coding.rs (JSONEncoder, JSONDecoder, PropertyListEncoder); springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs (set_data, data(uti)); springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (Representations::codable, data, JSON)
features.note: CodableRepresentation and DataRepresentation are declared on the model and reach the pasteboard, drag and item provider through one Transferable declaration (encoders are supplied as functions, no derive). Host tests only; verify on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/rich.rs (Payload::File with a document grant); springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs (dropped files arrive as App::document events with read-only grants); springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (Representations::file, SentTransferredFile, ReceivedTransferredFile)
features.note: FileRepresentation with sender and receiver roles and copy semantics (allow_open_in_place hands over the original). On a pasteboard item a file representation travels as bytes; no file promise in the shell yet. Host tests only; verify on Midget.

features.feature: Copy and paste of typed items
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs (NSPasteboard, change_count, write_objects); springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs; wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (pasteboard_item, from_pasteboard_item); springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard_types.rs (Board::best); springboard/src/shell/services/pasteboard_types.rs (best method); wired: springboard/apps/clock-desktop/src/clock/stopwatch.rs (Stopwatch::export_text), springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs; springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs (write_items, write_transferable, declare_types, pasteboard_items, read_objects); springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard_item.rs (NSPasteboardItem); springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard_promise.rs (DataProvider)
features.note: SDK writes carry every representation in one write and one change count step; NSPasteboardItem holds several types with lazy DataProvider promises resolved once; declareTypes(owner) and readObjects(forClasses) are modelled. The shell still publishes one rich type to the Wayland selection (shell/pasteboard.rs follow-up). Host tests only; verify on Midget.

features.feature: Drag and drop of typed items
features.apple: draggable and dropDestination (Transferable-based), NSDraggingSource and NSDraggingDestination
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs (register_types, begin, reply, performed); springboard/proto/src/rich.rs (DragItem, DragPreview); wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (begin_drag, drop_values); springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs
features.note: typed source and destination exist; no declarative per-model drag or drop modifier Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.
shares text, URLs and granted files; the share menu is not driven by Transferable representations

features.feature: Uniform type conformance used by transfers
features.apple: UTType identifiers used as representation types (via UniformTypeIdentifiers)
features.note: conformance and extension lookup exist; app-declared custom types for transfers were not verified

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs; wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (pasteboard_item hides OwnProcess representations)
features.note: Visibility All, Team and OwnProcess filter exports; proxy_of forwards another Transferable's bytes representations with the stricter visibility. Host tests only; verify on Midget.

gaps: Transferable and TransferRepresentation exist in the SDK (Sprint 10) but are not yet adopted by apps; verify on Midget before marking parity.
The Wayland clipboard publishes only one rich type at a time (springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs:33), so typed pasteboard data does not reach other apps in full.

Shell follow-up: springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs publishes one type to the Wayland selection and keeps items flat; it needs multi-MIME data sources and item grouping so the SDK's multi-representation writes (NativePasteboard::write_items) reach other apps in full, plus file promises for file representations.
proxy_of does not forward the proxied type's file representations; no derive-style CodableRepresentation (encoders are passed as functions).
